title: kiwi_for_carrot
description: Dedicated to DocM77 and all kiwi lovers of the earth (changes carrots into kiwifruit)
body: I was watching DocM77's video last friday, and he was talking about _docbubu_ (don't worry about it) But I realised that doc's kiwi habit is underapreciated in the community. So I wanted to show the kiwis some love by making a little recourcepack, how hard could it be? Well it worked, so I showed my friend (now co-author) and he said: "mein gott" This reaction was gold because I knew the reference was referencing. The rest was a blur but we did an entire photoshoot and now im writing this a week later during one of doc's streams (hes talking about american nipplephobia) totally normal saturday `¯\_(ツ)_/¯`
